headline: Favorable claims and investment gains outweigh a tax hit
summary_short: RGA's first-quarter net income rose 15.4% y/y to $330 million ($4.98 diluted EPS) as net premiums grew 14.3% to $4.6 billion and adjusted operating income reached $6.97 per diluted share, though the 24.9% effective tax rate ran above the company's stated 22%-23% expected range.
summary_long: Growth was broad-based: net premiums rose 14.3% y/y to $4.6 billion, helped by the Equitable Holdings coinsurance transaction and a $103 million FX tailwind. Net investment income rose on a larger asset base and a 4.93% average yield versus 4.64%. Gains were partly offset by $106 million of portfolio-repositioning losses and higher policy acquisition costs. Net income rose 15.4% to $330 million ($4.98 diluted EPS); adjusted operating income reached $6.97 per diluted share. The tax rate of 24.9% exceeded the company's stated 22%-23% expected range on higher foreign tax-credit valuation allowances. Book value per share rose 17.6% to $202.93; cash rose to $4.99 billion; RGA repurchased $50 million of shares and paid a $0.93 dividend.

drivers.explanation: Growth was primarily due to premiums received on the Equitable Holdings coinsurance transaction and continued business growth, plus a $103 million favorable foreign-currency effect.
Reflects the net-premium growth plus higher net investment income, driven by a larger average invested-asset base ($49.5B vs $44.0B) and a higher average yield (4.93% vs 4.64%).

Driven by the Equitable Holdings transaction (+$39 million pre-tax) and higher net investment income, partly offset by $106 million of portfolio-repositioning losses, higher derivative fair-value losses, and higher policy acquisition costs.
Tracked the net-income gain; diluted share count fell slightly (66.2M vs 66.9M) on buybacks, adding a modest per-share boost.
Driven mainly by a $132.50/share OCI gain from updating discount rates on future policy benefits, which more than offset a $98.70/share unrealized-securities markdown.
Rose q/q as the $2,873 million operating cash inflow outweighed financing outflows including $94 million of treasury-stock purchases and $61 million of dividends paid.
Rose q/q on $395 million of net proceeds from a new long-term debt issuance during the quarter, per the cash-flow statement.
Fell q/q as a $368 million net unrealized OCI loss (rate and credit-spread moves) plus $61 million of dividends and $50 million of buybacks outweighed the quarter's net income.

Exceeded the company's 22%-23% expected range primarily due to the jurisdictional mix of earnings and an increase in the valuation allowance on foreign tax credits, partly offset by additional credits.

Broad-based beat with favorable economic claims experience across all regions and continued benefits of RGA's diversified global platform; trailing-twelve-month ROE 9.7%, adjusted operating ROE 15.2% (16.2% excluding notable items).
